sentence: The room's organizing restates in the model's terms through its themes of coordination, building, defending, and celebrating, and the unused concepts, including Discord/IRC coordination and unplaced test posts, show no organizing the model lacks or contradicts.

The room's organizing restates in the model's terms - members move planning into Discord and spreadsheets (P23, P04), build and run shared bot targets (P14), call members to build, defend and repair the logo (P01, P05, P15), make room, deals and repair across the Swedish border with neighbours (P07, P08, P16, P19), carry the contest in talk (P06, P09, P18), are drawn in and welcomed by the work (P24, P25), and celebrate and record at the close (P11, P12, P13) - and none of the unused concepts (c0121, c0124, c0249, c0030, c0208, c0219, c0231) shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts.
